subject: Operations
title: Supplier Selection
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Supplier Selection.

hook.text: Boeing chose the cheapest wing bolt supplier. The bolts failed inspections. The savings vanished into rework costs.

buildup.text: Supplier selection weighs cost, quality, reliability, capacity, location, and financial stability.

discovery.text: Scorecards rank suppliers on weighted criteria so decisions are systematic, not gut-driven.

twist.text: The cheapest supplier often isn't the best. Hidden costs in quality failures, late deliveries, and expediting add up.

climax.text: Toyota builds deep relationships with fewer suppliers—investing in their growth in exchange for reliability.

punchline.text: Choose suppliers on total value, not just price.

quiz.question: Why is the cheapest supplier not always the best?
options: Hidden costs in quality and delays add up
